items.title: Henselian pairs are preserved under filtered colimits
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a filtered colimit of henselian pairs is again henselian, and the proof is a 25-line argument with two independent halves. For the radical condition it lifts an element of 1 + I to some stage and uses that the stage ideal lies in the Jacobson radical; for the lifting of factorisations it uses that both the ring and its quotient are filtered colimits to descend a monic polynomial together with a factorisation and a Bezout relation to a single stage, lifts the factorisation there by the henselian hypothesis, and maps back up. The descent to one stage is the step with content, since two different stages may be involved before the argument begins.
